places.name: Fujairah Adventure Park
places.description: Outdoor adventure park at the foot of the Hajar mountains with zip lines, rope courses, climbing walls, kayaking, a bike park with pump and dirt-jump tracks, and camping zones.

places.name: Al Ain Raceway
places.description: Floodlit 1.6 km international karting circuit at Al Ain Sportplex, with arrive-and-drive sessions for beginners, junior karting from age 7 and race events.

places.name: Shimal Archaeological Site & Queen of Sheba's Palace
places.description: Ras Al Khaimah's largest pre-Islamic site, on UNESCO's tentative list: Bronze Age tombs in the Hajar foothills and the ruins of a medieval hilltop palace reached by a staircase, with views over the Shimal palm oasis. No facilities, bring water.

places.name: Fujairah Heritage Village
places.description: Open-air heritage village next to Fujairah Fort showing traditional Emirati houses, tools and the old falaj irrigation system, with local handicrafts on display.
